chunks: So fear God and listen to me.

key_terms.فَاتَّقُوا: Fear God / Be conscious of God

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'So fear God and listen to me' in Surah Al-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse concludes the Prophet's dialogue with his skeptical tribe, emphasizing that true piety (taqwa) is inextricably linked to accepting the divinely appointed authority of the Messenger. Shia scholarship often extends this command of obedience ('ati'un) to include the Imams, viewing it as a continuation of the Prophet's authority and a prerequisite for valid spiritual practice. This establishes a dual foundation of internal God-consciousness and external adherence to religious leadership.
